messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired - eval_gate:SAFETY_REGRESSION for route `chat.generate`
  model: redwood-2-7b-quant-v3
  metric: toxicity_score (>0.8)
  window: 60m
  baseline -> current: 0.2% -> 4.8%
  alarm link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD123456
  eval dashboard: https://internal.redwood/evals/alerts/EVT-2026-03-15-01

Alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, will triage briefly and hand to ML if it's model quality. @Bob please standby.

Bob (ml-oncall): On it. pulling eval diffs now. The spike aligns with deploy id `deploy-2026-03-15-18` (rolled ~32m ago). Looks like the variant rolled to 20% earlier then auto-rolled to 100% for a subset of routes?

Carla (prod): Any signs of customer-visible errors (5xx, latency)? CS pinged?

Dan (eng-sre): Infra checks green (no container OOMs, no GPU errors). No rollout-related infra incidents. Logs show normal RT distribution. So likely model output quality change, not infra.

Erin (customer-success): I'm pinging the top 5 pilot customers on the pilot channel and watching support slack. No inbound tickets yet but I'll update if anything comes in.

Bob (ml-oncall): Confirmed: canary flag `auto_rollout=true` was present in the deploy. That allowed a staged promotion. Model quality eval gate should have blocked this — looks like the gate didn't trip until after promotion. Re-running evals on recent prompts to get sample diffs.

Alice (oncall): We need a mitigation path. Options: 1) force-rollback to previous pinned model, 2) route affected route to fallback model, 3) throttle rollout. Which is fastest?

Dan (eng-sre): Fastest is to switch route to baseline model. I'll prepare the route update.

Bob (ml-oncall): Agreed. Baseline `redwood-1-7b` has stable safety metrics. Recommend 100% traffic to `redwood-1-7b` for `chat.generate` until we investigate.

Dan (eng-sre): Executing now. Command I'm going to run:
```
# switch chat.generate to baseline model immediately
rwctl route update --route chat.generate --model redwood-1-7b --pct 100 --reason \"safety regression: EVT-2026-03-15-01\"
```

incident-bot: Action note: created incident ticket INC-7890 and linked PD PD123456. Incident runbook: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-7890

Alice (oncall): @Dan please post the exact command output here when complete. I'll update PagerDuty notes and set the incident status to \"mitigating\".

Dan (eng-sre): Ran the command, got 200 and rollout started. Route `chat.generate` now pointing to `redwood-1-7b` fully. Monitoring logs for the next few minutes.

Dan (eng-sre): Monitoring: sampling responses and re-running eval subset. Early signal: toxicity failure rate dropping back toward baseline (~0.3% at t+5m).

Bob (ml-oncall): Reran the safety eval on the last 10k prompts against `redwood-1-7b` and against the problematic `redwood-2-7b-quant-v3`. Results: baseline: 0.25% failures, bad variant: 4.6% failures. Screenshot and diff uploaded to eval dashboard.

Erin (customer-success): No customer reports so far. I sent a proactive note to pilots: short outage explanation + mitigation.

Carla (prod): Nice. Next steps: 1) keep route on baseline until we finish root cause, 2) pin rollout policy to manual, 3) post-mortem for eval gate timing/coverage.

Alice (oncall): I'll update the PagerDuty incident: mitigating -> monitoring. Leaving oncall assignment to Bob for post-mortem since this is model-quality.

Bob (ml-oncall): I'll own the follow-up. Immediate actions: snapshot failing prompts, run parameter-sensitivity checks, check tokenization differences and quantization artifacts. Creating a ticket: ML-2345 (postmortem + rollback root cause).

Dan (eng-sre): We'll also add a temporary alert to prevent auto-rollouts without eval gate clearance for 24h. Putting a short-lived policy lock.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD123456 status changed -> acknowledged by Alice (oncall) at 3501234570; mitigated flag set at 3501234680.

Alice (oncall): Great job team. I'll close the PD after 60m of stable metrics. Bob/Carla, please file the postmortem and link INC-7890. Erin, keep us posted if customers escalate. :thumbsup:

Bob (ml-oncall): Will do. Sample diffs + reproducer code attached in ML-2345.

Carla (prod): Adding a retro note: evaluate blocking threshold sensitivity — small calibration drift should not cause full-page.

Erin (customer-success): Will reply to pilots with mitigation summary.

Alice (oncall): Closing slack thread for now, monitoring channel only. If we see another spike, re-open the PD and ping SRE + ML.

Dan (eng-sre): final check: metrics URL https://metrics.redwood/alerts/EVT-2026-03-15-01 shows steady fall back to baseline. Leaving monitors on 5m cadence.

incident-bot: Incident INC-7890 updated: status=mitigated, owner=Bob (ml-oncall), linked PD=PD123456

Alice (oncall): Thanks everyone.
